98	    for node in ast.walk(tree):
99	        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
100	            continue
101	        f = node.func
102	        target = False   # False — не удаление; иначе узел-цель (или None)
103	        if isinstance(f, ast.Attribute):
104	            on_os = isinstance(f.value, ast.Name) and f.value.id in os_names
105	            if f.attr == "rmtree":
106	                target = arg0(node)
107	            elif f.attr in DEL_OS and on_os:
108	                target = arg0(node)
109	            elif f.attr in ("unlink", "rmdir"):
110	                target = arg0(node) if on_os else f.value
111	            elif f.attr in ("system", "popen") and on_os and node.args:
112	                text = const_str(node.args[0], env)
113	                if text is not None:
114	                    yield from scan_text(text, ctx, depth=depth + 1)
115	            elif f.attr in SUBPROC and isinstance(f.value, ast.Name) and f.value.id == "subprocess" and node.args:
116	                a = node.args[0]
117	                if isinstance(a, (ast.List, ast.Tuple)):
118	                    words = [const_str(e, env) or "$?" for e in a.elts]
119	                    yield from scan_one(Cmd(words), ctx, {}, (), depth + 1)
120	                else:
121	                    s = const_str(a, env)
122	                    if s is not None:
123	                        yield from scan_text(s, ctx, depth=depth + 1)
124	        elif isinstance(f, ast.Name) and f.id in funcs:
125	            target = arg0(node)
126	        if target is not False:
127	            v = const_str(target, env) if target is not None else None
128	            yield (v if v is not None else UNKNOWN_TARGET, ctx.copy())

131	def find_scan(args, ctx, vars_, depth):
132	    k = 0
133	    while k < len(args) and args[k] in ("-H", "-L", "-P", "-E", "-X", "-x", "-s"):
134	        k += 1
135	    paths = []
136	    while k < len(args) and not (args[k].startswith("-") or args[k] in ("!", "(", ")")):
137	        paths.append(args[k])
138	        k += 1
139	    expr = args[k:]
140	    deleting = "-delete" in expr
141	    overwriting = False
142	    extra = []
143	    k = 0
144	    while k < len(expr):
145	        if expr[k] in ("-exec", "-execdir", "-ok", "-okdir"):
146	            sub = []
147	            k += 1
148	            while k < len(expr) and expr[k] not in (";", "+"):
149	                sub.append(expr[k])
150	                k += 1
151	            inner = list(scan_one(Cmd(sub), ctx, vars_, (), depth + 1))
152	            if any(not isinstance(x[0], (Over, Forbid)) for x in inner):
153	                deleting = True                     # внутри -exec удаление: целью становятся и пути find
154	            for x in inner:

157	                    if head:                        # `cp a /dir/{}` — члены каталога неизвестны: сам каталог как цель

161	            extra += [x for x in inner if "{}" not in x[0]]
162	        elif expr[k] in ("-fprint", "-fprint0", "-fprintf", "-fls") and k + 1 < len(expr):

169	    if deleting:

174	        yield from (x for x in extra if isinstance(x[0], (Over, Forbid)))

178	    j = 0
179	    ident = []
180	    while j < len(args):
181	        a = args[j]
182	        if a == "--":

184	            break
185	        if a.startswith("-") and len(a) > 1:

"""CP8: `docs/configuration.md` совпадает с кодом — переменные окружения `RPV_*` и ключи `.claude/rpv.json`, которые читает
код плагина, и только они, описаны в документе."""
import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DOC = ROOT / "docs" / "configuration.md"
SOURCES = [p for pattern in (".claude/dispatcher/*.py", ".claude/hooks/*.py", "hooks/*", "tools/*")
           for p in ROOT.glob(pattern) if p.is_file() and not p.name.startswith(("test_", "conftest"))]
ENV_RE = re.compile(r"""RPV_[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*|\b(?:P\.env|_env|env)\(\s*["']([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)["']""")
KEY_RE = re.compile(r"""\bsetting\(\s*["']([a-z_]+)["']|_str_list\(data,\s*["']([a-z_]+)["']|data\.get\(["'](guard_[a-z_]+)["']""")


def code_names():
    env, keys = set(), set()
    for p in SOURCES:
        text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        for m in ENV_RE.finditer(text):
            env.add(m.group(0) if m.group(0).startswith("RPV_") else "RPV_" + m.group(1))
        for m in KEY_RE.finditer(text):
            keys.add(next(g for g in m.groups() if g))
    return env, keys


class ConfigurationDocTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_env_names_match_code(self):
        env, _ = code_names()
        documented = set(re.findall(r"`(RPV_[A-Z0-9_]+)`", DOC.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(env - documented), [], "переменная читается кодом, но не описана")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(documented - env), [], "описана, но код её не читает")
        self.assertLessEqual(len(env), 10, "CP8: переменных — несколько, остальное — rpv.json или константы")

    def test_settings_keys_match_code(self):
        _, keys = code_names()
        documented = set(re.findall(r"^\| `([a-z_]+)` \|", DOC.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), re.M))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(keys - documented), [], "ключ rpv.json читается кодом, но не описан")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(documented - keys), [], "ключ описан, но код его не читает")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
